description: Fix broken Google OAuth login (ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID with 0.0.0.0 redirect) and remove GitHub OAuth completely.

userStories.title: Fix NextAuth Google OAuth redirect configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want Google login to redirect me to the dashboard without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify source of 0.0.0.0 redirect in NextAuth config or callbacks
Ensure NEXTAUTH_URL uses localhost:3000 (not 0.0.0.0)
Update NextAuth callbacks to use correct base URL for redirects
Redirect to /[locale]/dashboard after successful Google login
Preserve user's locale during OAuth flow
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created src/lib/url.ts with getBaseUrl(). Fixed login-form.tsx, signup-form.tsx, callback/route.ts, middleware.ts to use unified env var strategy (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL > NEXTAUTH_URL > origin fallback).

userStories.title: Remove GitHub OAuth provider from NextAuth config
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove GitHub as an authentication provider from the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove GitHub provider from NextAuth providers array
Remove GITHUB_ID and GITHUB_SECRET references from auth config
Remove any GitHub-specific callback handlers if present
Verify only Google provider remains (plus CredentialsProvider if used)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Removed GithubProvider import and config from src/lib/auth.ts. Removed console.log of GitHub env vars. Updated comment in callback/route.ts.
